'''Chapter 780''' is titled "The Heart Curse".

==Cover Page==
[[Solo Journey of Jinbe, Knight of the Sea]] Vol. 24: "We Sunk the Ruins Near the Harbor".

The Sea Kitten's home has been returned to the ocean floor.

==Short Summary==
Previously, [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] and [[Trebol]] overwhelmed [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]]. Doflamingo told Law that he would grant him one wish if Law performed the Perennial Youth Operation on him. However, Law mocked Doflamingo, and was shot repeatedly.

In the present, [[Riku Doldo III|Riku]] gathers more people to help the citizens, and [[Viola]] sees that Law has fallen. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] makes it back to the rooftop, where he attacks Doflamingo repeatedly. As Luffy notices Law lying on the ground, the [[Ito Ito no Mi#Other Techniques|Birdcage]] begins to shrink.

==Long Summary==
As [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] calls [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] to the rooftop, it is shown what happened a few minutes earlier. [[Trebol]] used [[Beta Beta no Mi#Named Techniques|Sticky Launcher]] to send Law sprawling at the edge of the roof, and he and Doflamingo stood over the severely injured [[Shichibukai]]. Trebol expressed his surprise that Law was still alive, mockingly suggesting that he give up. Doflamingo echoed his executive's thoughts, telling Law he pitied how everything he'd done - escaping the [[Flevance|White City]], meeting [[Donquixote Rosinante|Corazon]], working for 13 years to depose Doflamingo, and his alliance with Luffy - had been worthless. As he pointed his gun at Law's chest, Doflamingo offered him a deal: a chance to make the rest of Law's short life meaningful by performing the [[Ope Ope no Mi#Strengths|Perennial Youth Operation]] on him. In exchange, Doflamingo offered to make any wish of Law's come true.

Law appeared to accept at first, but then requested that Doflamingo bring his dead brother Corazon back to life and submit himself to all the citizens of [[Dressrosa]]. Law laughed that Doflamingo's life was the pitiful one, saying that the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] can cause miracles, and raised his middle finger at Doflamingo. Doflamingo shot Law eight times in various places, mocking the word "Corazon" on Law's jacket. He furiously yelled that despite all Law's efforts to imitate Corazon, the legacy of the Heart will end.

Across the island, [[Tank Lepanto]] and the crowd of citizens on the King's Plateau decide to climb down to the city in order to assist their former king [[Riku Doldo III|Riku]]. [[Viola]] confirms to [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Usopp]] that of the opposing forces, only Doflamingo and Trebol remain standing, but their own forces have also taken a hit.

Meanwhile, Luffy breaks through the palace roof, eager to fight Doflamingo. The Shichibukai taunts him about [[Bellamy]], and blocks a [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques|Gear 3 punch]] with [[Ito Ito no Mi#Other Techniques|Spider's Web]]. Luffy leaps over the web and uses [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques#Gear 2 Haki Enhanced Attacks|Hawk Gatling]] to attack Doflamingo from above, but Doflamingo uses [[Ito Ito no Mi#Other Techniques|Break White]] to surround Luffy in a mass of strings.

Luffy breaks out of Doflamingo's trap but steps on a pool of blood. Looking around, he sees Law lying on the ground. In confusion, Luffy asks Law what has happened, but he remains unresponsive. Doflamingo tells Luffy that Law is dead, shocking the pirate. As the citizens of Dressrosa realize that the [[Ito Ito no Mi#Other Techniques|Birdcage]] is shrinking, Doflamingo mocks Law's last words and states that it is time for the game to end. Luffy prepares to fight but faintly hears Law's voice telling him to listen closely.
